card.name: Linking words in dosing schedules
card.fires_on: Small linking words right before a time span or quantity in dosing directions, such as "every" or "over a period of" before a number of weeks. Also "same" before "intravenous line".

modes.label: Interval or taper wording
modes.description: Words like every, of or in just before a number of weeks or an increment size.
modes.example: increase the dosage<< every>> 4 to 6 weeks as needed

modes.label: Same line wording
modes.description: The word same before intravenous line in mixing instructions.
modes.example: Do not co-administer Proleukin with other drugs through the<< same>> intravenous line.

modes.label: Limit or start words
modes.description: Words like beyond or start that introduce a limit or starting step.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before a time span, like "every" or "over a period of", in dosing directions.
